This implies a cascade where Progesterone is indirectly linked to the target protein via androstenedione. The relationship is mediated by the intermediate step of androstenedione, which may modulate the activity of Kallistatin and subsequently influence the function of the G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-2. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential regulatory mechanism where Progesterone's effects are mediated through androstenedione, suggesting a possible role in cellular signaling or metabolic regulation.
